scope: Theorem 1.1 (Sharp soft-channel contraction) of the manuscript “Sharp binary-information contraction on the discrete cube” (preprints/Sharp-binary-information-contraction-on-the-discrete-cube-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 119 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 01a59d40aaecfb1d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every finite n ≥ 0, every u : Ωn → [−1, 1], and −1 ≤ ρ ≤ 1, I(Tρu) ≤ ψ  |ρ| ψ−1 (I(u))  . (1.1) The inverse is the nonnegative increasing branch on [0, L]. For n ≥ 1, every soft coordinate u(x) = axi, |a| ≤ 1, attains equality.
